# Image Compressor Pro

> Free, 100% client-side online image compressor running directly in your browser. Compress up to 20 images at once with adjustable quality and zero server uploads.

## Overview

- [Image Compressor Pro](https://image-compressor.imagecompress.in/): Main web application for batch image compression (supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF).
- [Source Code on GitHub](https://github.com/madhurimondal89/image-compressor-app): Open-source repository under the MIT License.

## Key Features

- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: All image compression runs locally in the user's browser via HTML5 Canvas—files never leave the device.
- **Batch Compression**: Compress up to 20 images simultaneously via drag-and-drop or file picker.
- **Adjustable Quality Slider**: Fine-tune compression quality from 10% to 100% with instant compressed size previews.
- **Format Preservation**: Preserves JPEG, WebP, and transparent PNG formats.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://image-compressor.imagecompress.in/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search engine and AI crawler discovery.
- [Robots.txt](https://image-compressor.imagecompress.in/robots.txt): Crawler access rules permitting indexing of the site.
